body.name: Fithandle
body.def: On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one tensor-product B-spline product likelihood for \((\pi,M_A,M_Z,f)\) with total dimension \(s_n\), choose from the \(K!\) common label permutations the one maximizing the empirical minimum, across training observations and latent classes, of the diagonal-minus-largest-off-diagonal self-report probability, and compute \((w,W,B,d,D,R,N,h,G,b_{(\cdot)},b_U)\) only as plug-in implications of that fitted law
body.role: Starting move for constructing coherent nuisances with explicit rates.
